package.description: ✨ Launch anything without any UAC prompts.

en-US.description: ✨ Launch anything without any UAC prompts.
en-US.longDescription:
✨ Launch anything without any UAC prompts. 
This utility lets you launch programs with elevated privileges without triggering any UAC prompts.
Simply select one or more files and press the hotkey (default: 'Alt + Win + Left Mouse Button', or 'Alt + Win + R') to run them as administrator automatically.
You can also execute programs from the command prompt by typing 'elev' followed by the program to launch.
en-US.name: Elevated Launcher

it-IT.description: ✨ Avvia qualsiasi programma. Senza prompt UAC.
it-IT.longDescription:
✨ Avvia qualsiasi programma. Senza prompt UAC. 
Questa utility permette di avviare qualsiasi programma con privilegi elevati senza attivare i prompt UAC. 
Seleziona uno o più file e premi la scorciatoia da tastiera (default: 'Alt + Win + Tasto sinistro del mouse', o 'Alt + Win + R') e verrano lanciati automaticamente come amministratore.
Puoi anche avviarli da prompt digitando 'elev' e il programma da eseguire.
